_description: Minimal employee creation scenario for the /employees/create form.
Title is 'Driver' — a NON-licensed title, so the SCFHS/NPHIES license
section stays hidden and only the base required fields are needed:
Name, Title, Gender, Nationality, ID Type, National ID, ID Expiration
date and Religion. (Branches/Systems are pre-selected and locked.)
nationalId is validated server-side for UNIQUENESS — the loader's DYNAMIC
generator always produces a fresh value.
name: DYNAMIC
title: Driver
